Container.Name: hivestack
Container.Overview: Local-first AI agent & AIOps platform running fully offline on Tesla M40 (Maxwell CC 5.2). Single container with provider gate, RAG, MCP, workflows, AIOps, governance.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ai aops local-first offline m40 rag mcp ollama
Container.Description:
Local-first AI agent platform with a per-provider on/off gate, Web UI, and Tesla M40 (Maxwell) GPU support.
Features - Local-first: runs fully offline; every outside provider (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/...) ships with its own enable switch - Web UI: dashboard, chat, agents, workflows, boards, memory, skills, studio, comms, AIOps, governance, economy, settings - Single container: API + UI; persistent /config /data /models volumes - M40-ready: CC 5.2 (Ollama/llama.cpp, driver branch 580)
Parameters: set a strong admin password and (optionally) the GPU UUID.

Config.Name: Config path
Config.Description: Persistent config (config.yaml seeded on first boot)

Config.Name: GPU UUID(s)
Config.Description: NVIDIA devices to expose. Run 'nvidia-smi -L' on Unraid to get UUID. For Tesla M40 (GPU 1), use its UUID (e.g., GPU-xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx). 'all' = every GPU.
